== page
PURPOSE
The request should read as one block under its head line.                                         

PRINCIPLE
Indent after wrapping, not before; one rule for every indented block on the page.                 

GOAL
A request's text on a task's page keeps its 3-column indent on every wrapped line, not only the   
first.                                                                                            

▸ ACCEPTANCE · j/k or [ ] step · Space ticks · - strikes out                                        
> ☐ 1. A request and its answer wrap with their indent kept, at 100x30 (golden, fails on main first)

DEPENDENCIES
  ↳ w0rap1 The task this one waits on, with a title long enough to fill a row [todo] open the row
    this note is on is long enough that the page has to wrap it, and its second line must hang under
    the first
  ⧗ when date 2099-01-01 WAITING · today is 2026-11-22 · wakes rooster

CHILDREN (1)
  ↳ w0rap1 The task this one waits on, with a title long enough to fill a row [todo]

   your questions as links; yours opens the page scrolled to the question where it sits.
   └ ox: Scroll to the question; no block at the top. A second sentence makes this answer long
     enough to wrap on a page a hundred columns wide.
